shows: pH, precipitant class, space groups, release years, LBD mutation status, chains per ASU
takeaway: 307/351 entries report a pH (median 8.3); 323 PEG-grown; most common space group P 1 21 1 (201 entries); coactivator/other peptide in 210 entries.

shows: PCA of RMSD rows, classical MDS, metric MDS, t-SNE and UMAP, coloured by S08 cluster
takeaway: All five maps separate cl7 from cl4; classical MDS keeps 77% of the positive spectrum in 2-D; highest trustworthiness tsne (0.937).

shows: best setting of each method family drawn on the shared metric-MDS map, colours matched to S08
takeaway: 17 of 76 runs with >=2 clusters reproduce the cl7/cl4 split with ARI > 0.9 on the 774 main-cluster chains.

shows: silhouette vs bootstrap stability for all runs, best setting per family, silhouette vs K
takeaway: Selected by the declared rule: spectral|sigma=2.0,k=2 (K=2, silhouette 0.74, stability ARI 1.00); 4 of the top 10 runs have K=2.

shows: mean intra RMSD / medoid radius / diameter for S08 clusters; cohesion-separation per cluster and per run
takeaway: cl7 (n=445) has mean intra RMSD 0.70 A and diameter 3.1 A, cl4 (n=329) 0.91 A / 2.4 A; cohesion/separation 0.33 vs 0.61.

shows: ARI and AMI between the best run of every family and S08; contingency S08 x selected run
takeaway: The selected run (spectral|sigma=2.0,k=2) puts the 445 cl7 and 329 cl4 chains in separate clusters and absorbs the 14 minor-cluster chains; top-family ARI vs S08 0.89-0.98.

shows: alluvial of chain membership from S08 through the selected run and four other methods
takeaway: The cl7/cl4 ribbons stay separate through spectral, k-means, average linkage and GMM; HDBSCAN and PAM merge or interleave them.

shows: S08 average-linkage dendrogram (788 leaves) with nine metadata colour bars
takeaway: The cl7/cl4 branches coincide with coactivator peptide (present/absent), Y537S vs L536S constructs and complete vs partial H12, while quality bars (tier, R-free, B-group) are mixed along both branches.

shows: 788 x 788 RMSD heatmap ordered by dendrogram leaves with cluster, tier, H12, peptide and mutation sidebars
takeaway: Two dark diagonal blocks; the cl4 block has visible sub-blocks (more internal heterogeneity) and the off-diagonal is uniformly ~3.5 A.

shows: UMAP of the ligand Tanimoto distance coloured by chemistry cluster and by structural cluster
takeaway: 192 ligands sit only in cl7 chains and 104 only in cl4 chains; see Y25 for the formal test.

shows: selection score per fingerprint x method, silhouette vs K on the chosen fingerprint, silhouette vs stability
takeaway: The declared rule selects MACCS|hier_average|k=2 (K=2, largest cluster 99%); requiring a largest cluster <= 60% gives MACCS|kmeans_mds|k=6 (K=6). Chemistry silhouettes stay modest (0.29 max).

shows: physchem descriptor distributions of cl7-only vs cl4-only ligands with Mann-Whitney / Fisher BH q
takeaway: Median MW 470 vs 344 g/mol (cl4 vs cl7, q=9e-18); basic amine in 74% of cl4 vs 1% of cl7 ligands (q=7e-44).

shows: 12 most common Murcko scaffolds, counts split by the structural cluster of the ligand's chains
takeaway: 7/12 top scaffolds are confined to one structural cluster; 169 distinct scaffolds in 306 ligands.

shows: per-residue distance between cl7 and cl4 mean C-alpha positions and medoids, within-cluster spread, observation rate
takeaway: Largest shifts at 550, 549, 548 (36.9 A max); positions 528-550 hold 99% of the squared difference; cl4 chains observe H12 less often (86% vs 98%).

shows: C-alpha contact-frequency maps of cl7 and cl4 and their difference
takeaway: 68 residue pairs differ by > 0.5 in contact frequency; 35 involve H12 (H12 packs on H3/H11 in cl7 and on H3/H5 in the AF-2 groove in cl4).

shows: 12 per-chain structural features (H12 geometry, helix angles, charge clamp, pocket and ligand size) by cluster
takeaway: H12-H3 angle 82 vs 43 deg, H12-H11 distance 20.2 vs 26.8 A; pocket size and the H2-H3 loop differ less (|r| 0.58, 0.78).

shows: PCA of circular-encoded phi/psi over positions observed in >= 90% of chains; dPC1 loadings and mean psi differences along the sequence
takeaway: dPC1 explains 19% of dihedral variance; largest loadings at 537, 329, 359, 457; cl7/cl4 silhouette 0.66 without any superposition.

shows: depth-3 decision tree (class-balanced) on quality, crystal, construct and ligand variables
takeaway: The first splits use the peptide / mutation and the ligand's basic amine, not quality variables.

shows: cross-validated balanced accuracy per feature group and model; permutation importance; mutual information
takeaway: Quality variables predict the split less well (0.80; quality is confounded with construct and crystal form, see Y14/Y16); construct (0.96) and ligand chemistry (0.89) predict it well; top single feature h12_h3_angle (MI 0.66).

shows: forest plots of binary (log OR) and continuous (rank-biserial) hypotheses at chain and entry level; BH q
takeaway: Peptide presence, Y537S/L536S constructs and the ligand basic amine have the largest effects; adding resolution/R-free/mean B to peptide+mutation gains McFadden R2 0.053 (LR p=5.3e-12).

shows: flags of five outlier methods on the shared MDS map, consensus, agreement counts and Jaccard overlap
takeaway: 22 consensus outliers in 17 entries; 14 of them sit inside a main cluster, the rest are the minor clusters.

shows: quality metrics of consensus outliers vs the rest; effect-size heatmap for every outlier group and variable; verdict counts
takeaway: 6/22 consensus outliers are explained by quality (or a missing H12), 16 are well-determined structures in an unusual conformation; see outlier_verdicts.csv.

shows: effect size of every mmCIF metadata variable against cluster and consensus-outlier status (chain and entry level); space group x cluster
takeaway: Strongest cluster associations at entry level: space_group8, oligomer_state, mutation_status; pH and precipitant class are weaker; all entries are X-ray structures.

shows: the same map coloured by ligand chemistry cluster, basic amine, ligand size, supported action label, pocket size, H12 geometry, 537 dihedral, H12/core B
takeaway: Basic-amine ligands, large ligands and large pockets sit in cl4; the H12 geometry variables change abruptly at the cluster border.

shows: the same map coloured by space group, crystal system, pH, precipitant, peptide, mutation, year, method, ASU, PEG size
takeaway: P21 / NCOA2 peptide / Y537S cover cl7; P1, C2, P3x and L536S cover cl4; PEG is everywhere (no signal).

shows: PCA (RMSD rows) map coloured by cluster, peptide, mutation, basic amine, R-free, B, pH, space group
takeaway: The PCA map reproduces the MDS picture: PC1 is the H12 state, set by construct and ligand, not by quality.

shows: metric-MDS map of the RMSD matrix coloured by cluster, R-free, resolution, B-factors, B-group, tier, H12 label, outlier count, R-work, completeness, core RMSD
takeaway: Quality variables are mixed across the map; cl4 even holds more high-resolution chains; H12 partial/not modelled concentrates in cl4.

shows: interactive scatter (plotly, offline) of five embeddings with hover: PDB id, chain, cluster, quality, ligand, peptide, mutation
takeaway: Open in a browser to look up any chain; the dropdown switches between MDS, PCA, t-SNE and UMAP.

shows: scree plot, projections of all 788 chains on coordinate modes 1-3, cPC1 against PC1 of the RMSD rows
takeaway: cPC1 explains 86% of coordinate variance and correlates with the RMSD-based PC1 (Spearman 0.78); distances in cPC1-3 space track S04 RMSD (Spearman 0.81).

shows: per-residue loading magnitude of coordinate modes 1-3 along the ESR1 sequence with helix bands
takeaway: Modes 1-3 load almost only on H12 (538-544) and the 528-537 loop; the helical core has near-zero loading in every mode.

shows: rank of each helix by median normalised B in the low/mid/high B-groups (bump chart) and per-chain core B, core v3 vs old core
takeaway: Core v3 helices (H3, H4/5, H7, H8, H10/11) stay in the better half in every B-group; per chain the core-v3 normalised B (median 0.928) is lower than on the old core (1.038).

shows: median normalised B per helix by B-group, cluster and tier (with ranks); per-chain core v3 / old core / H12 B by cluster; per-residue B profile cl7 vs cl4
takeaway: The helix ranking is stable across all groups; H12 is relatively more mobile in cl4 (H12/core-v3 ratio 1.53 vs 1.33 in cl7).

section: I. ESR2 and ESR1 vs ESR2
shows: ESR2 metric-MDS map coloured by cluster, peptide, resolution, outliers; ESR2 clustering zoo; space groups
takeaway: ESR2 shows the ESR1 pattern: the main basin (68 chains) is peptide-bound, the second (12) is not; 8 chains are kNN/LOF outliers; small N, descriptive only.

section: I. ESR2 and ESR1 vs ESR2
shows: metric MDS of the joint 874 x 874 ESR1+ESR2 RMSD matrix; median RMSD between receptor/state groups
takeaway: Same-state cross-receptor distances (1.33 / 2.31 A) are far below the ESR1 cl7-cl4 distance (3.49 A).

section: I. ESR2 and ESR1 vs ESR2
shows: per-position distance between ESR1 and ESR2 mean C-alpha traces in the same H12 state, sequence differences, draft selectivity residues, E10 positions
takeaway: Backbone differences between the receptors are small in the core and concentrate in loops; the pocket selectivity residues differ in side chain (L384M, M421I), not in backbone position.

section: I. ESR2 and ESR1 vs ESR2
shows: median pChEMBL at ESR1 vs ESR2 per compound, selectivity distribution (all assays and Ki/Kd only), selectivity of PDB ligands by structural cluster
takeaway: 54% of 1615 compounds are within 10-fold between receptors; 295 are >10-fold ESR1-selective and 441 >10-fold ESR2-selective.

shows: chem cluster x structural majority (ligand level), permutation null of the chi-square, potency by cluster within chemistry clusters
takeaway: Cramer's V 0.43 (CI 0.40-0.55); the cl4-cl7 potency gap is +1.13 log units raw and +0.83 within chemistry clusters.

shows: nearest-neighbour agreement of structural majority by Tanimoto bin; hexbin of ligand-pair Tanimoto vs median inter-chain RMSD
takeaway: 89% of ligands share the H12 state of their nearest chemical neighbour (null 51%); Spearman Tanimoto vs RMSD -0.17.

shows: Hill numbers q0/q1/q2 across partitions, methods, cores and subsets; redundancy per S08 cluster
takeaway: Whatever the method or subset, q1 stays near 2.2: the set holds about two conformations; q0 depends on how many singletons a method makes.

shows: rarefaction of cluster discovery for four partitions and of conformational coverage at 1.0 / 1.5 A
takeaway: Cluster counts are driven by rare singletons (n90 ~490 chains at 1.5 A), while coverage of the chains saturates fast (90% within 1.0 A after ~6 random chains).

shows: greedy set-cover size by radius and coverage target; 90% at 1.0 A by subset, core and representative rule
takeaway: 2 complete-H12 representatives cover 90% of all chains at 1.0 A and 2 at 1.5 A; the result barely changes for tier A, one-chain-per-entry or the old core.

shows: novelty of each chain (min RMSD to earlier-released chains) by release year; cumulative Hill q0/q1 over time
takeaway: New structures since 2010 almost always repeat a known conformation (median novelty 0.38 A); the effective number of conformations has been ~2 since both states appeared.

shows: chains released per year stacked by cluster with cumulative count; median resolution and R-free per year
takeaway: cl4 appears in 1998 and cl7 in 1998; the peak year 2016 (149 chains) is mostly cl7.

shows: heatmaps of main-split agreement and ARI vs S08 for 6 methods x 4 matrices (2 cores + 2 negative controls) x 5 subsets
takeaway: Main-split agreement 0.98-1.00 for every method/subset on core v3 and the old core; the H12-free controls drop to 0.53-0.97.

shows: PyMOL B-factor putty of both complete-H12 medoids (normalised C-alpha B)
takeaway: Mobility concentrates in H12 and the loops that also carry the cl7/cl4 difference.

shows: PyMOL cartoon of the complete-H12 medoids of cl7 and cl4 in the S03 frame, H12 opaque, two views
takeaway: Everything except H12 (and two loops) overlays; H12 occupies two different positions.

shows: triangle-inequality excess, hubness of incomplete chains, split strength per position set
takeaway: 5.4% of triples violate the triangle inequality (max excess 6.5 A); without positions 528-550 the cl7/cl4 split nearly disappears (silhouette 0.19; the 1.5 A cut gives 1 cluster).

shows: metric MDS of four region-restricted RMSD matrices coloured by S08 cluster
takeaway: Median cl7-cl4 distance is 14.0 A on H12 alone but 0.82 A without H12/loop: the split is an H12 position split.

shows: RMSD distributions for chain pairs from the same entry, other entries with the same ligand, other ligands; largest within-entry RMSD; entries with copies in different clusters
takeaway: NCS copies median 0.54 A, same ligand other entry 0.65 A, other ligand 1.38 A; 5 of 317 multi-chain entries are split across clusters.

shows: crystal-contact atoms around H12 (symmetry mates, other ASU chains, peptide) by cluster and H12 label; contacts vs H12 shift in cl4
takeaway: Median contact atoms cl7 1 vs cl4 10 (p=6e-70); partial-H12 cl4 chains have 8 vs 18 for complete (p=1e-16).

shows: MDS of the cl4 sub-matrix coloured by sub-cluster; feature heatmap per sub-cluster; per-residue profile between the two largest sub-clusters
takeaway: At 1.0 A cl4 splits into 262 + 48 chains (+ small groups); see the heatmap for which variables separate them.
